commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+2' That didn't go as planned! Abdon Prats (Mallorca) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Vicente Guaita, who easily kept it out.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
89' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Jose Copete (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
88' The game has begun to heat up. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
85' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) replacing Carlos Dotor.
80' Substitution. Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca) on for Toni Lato.
79' Jose Copete (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.
76' Victor Garcia couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) and blew his whistle.
75' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post.
75' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

75' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Vicente Guaita. The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
73' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.

71' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
70' Rafael Benitez prepares a substitution. Iago Aspas is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
70' Here comes a substitution. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Manu Morlanes.
70' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Antonio Sanchez will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
66' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) makes a strong challenge and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
65' That's the end of the game for Samu Costa, who is replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
63' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
62' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
62' Mallorca take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
60' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.
56' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' One of the Celta Vigo players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
54' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Victor Garcia saw the whole situation.
52' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Rafael Benitez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Carles Perez (Celta Vigo). He is replaced by Miguel Rodriguez.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The linesman signals that Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
43' 1 - 1 Cyle Larin (Mallorca) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and sends a low drive past the goalkeeper.
43' Samu Costa (Mallorca) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the right post.
41' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
40' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
37' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
34' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
31' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
30' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
30' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo). The ball is out of play. Mallorca win a corner kick.
29' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
28' Toni Lato (Mallorca) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

23' Ambitious effort from Cyle Larin (Mallorca). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
21' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
20' It looks like Samu Costa (Mallorca) saw red with that tackle. Victor Garcia won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
18' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Vicente Guaita produces a wonderful reflex save.
16' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Jorgen Strand Larsen provides Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the top left corner. 0:1.
9' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
7' Celta Vigo keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
5' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
4' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Victor Garcia.
